mapper.select: SELECT id, ticket_no, conversation_id, source_turn_id, owner_user_id, title, problem_description, attempted_actions, status, root_cause, solution, close_reason, version, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, resolved_by, resolved_at, closed_by, closed_at FROM ticket WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket (ticket_no, conversation_id, source_turn_id, owner_user_id, title, problem_description, attempted_actions, status, root_cause, solution, close_reason, version, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, resolved_by, resolved_at, closed_by, closed_at) VALUES (#{ticketNo}, #{conversationId}, #{sourceTurnId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{title}, #{problemDescription}, #{attemptedActions}, #{status}, #{rootCause}, #{solution}, #{closeReason}, #{version}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{resolvedBy}, #{resolvedAt}, #{closedBy}, #{closedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket SET ticket_no=#{ticketNo}, title=#{title}, problem_description=#{problemDescription}, attempted_actions=#{attemptedActions}, status=#{status}, root_cause=#{rootCause}, solution=#{solution}, close_reason=#{closeReason}, version=#{version}, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_at=#{updatedAt}, resolved_by=#{resolvedBy}, resolved_at=#{resolvedAt}, closed_by=#{closedBy}, closed_at=#{closedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} - 1
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, input_type, original_file_name, media_type, raw_content, content_hash, status, version, index_failure_reason, archive_reason, deleted, deleted_by, deleted_at, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, published_by, published_at, archived_by, archived_at FROM managed_document WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE managed_document SET title=#{title},raw_content=#{rawContent},content_hash=#{contentHash}, status=#{status},version=#{version},index_failure_reason=#{indexFailureReason}, archive_reason=#{archiveReason},deleted=#{deleted},deleted_by=#{deletedBy},deleted_at=#{deletedAt}, updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_at=#{updatedAt},published_by=#{publishedBy},published_at=#{publishedAt}, archived_by=#{archivedBy},archived_at=#{archivedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} - 1

UPDATE resolved_case SET title=#{title},problem=#{problem},cause=#{cause},solution=#{solution}, status=#{status},content_hash=#{contentHash},version=#{version}, publish_failure_reason=#{publishFailureReason},rejection_reason=#{rejectionReason}, archive_reason=#{archiveReason},deleted=#{deleted},deleted_by=#{deletedBy},deleted_at=#{deletedAt}, updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_at=#{updatedAt},published_by=#{publishedBy},published_at=#{publishedAt}, archived_by=#{archivedBy},archived_at=#{archivedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} - 1
